Specification: This specification models a TLC test for worker consistency when evaluating a transition that uses RandomElement and TLC shared state. It initializes x to 0, repeatedly increments x while storing X into register r, where X is a singleton set containing RandomElement(1..10000). The spec is Init /\ [][Next]_x. The postcondition checks that workers agree on the stored register value, validates TLC-reported metadata, and the model includes both a state constraint and an action constraint.
